evidence: Read all 55 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3). Each states one conjunctive full-credit bar whose closing 'Fails if ...' list restates the same requirements as the body; none enumerates requirements and then waives most of them. Every carve-out is narrow and consistent with the bar, and every 'scored elsewhere' waiver points to a sibling that actually grades the waived item: both modifiers (multi_caret_delete:110, same_line_carets:119) -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic:101, which requires both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click; first-run output left in the preview (basic_run_output:218) -> cw_run_starts_fresh_document:263; conflict message (stale_save_keeps_draft:362) -> cw_stale_save_refused:353; repeated restore (history_restore_adds_revision:371) -> cw_restore_request_repeat_safe:380; earlier picture (time_limit_recovery:299, stop_cancels_pending_work:308) -> cw_last_good_recovery:290; reason for the run ending (output_before_failure_kept:254) -> the stop, time-limit and error criteria; Run correctness (polish feedback/narrow) -> functional. Allowances such as 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' (format criteria 191/200) do not conflict with the bar: the protected characters are inside the string or attribute value, not the quotes. The same holds for disabled Redo being enough (replace_all_atomic:155), the first match already current (find:137), refused-or-appended restore (history_restore:371) and static restored preview (last_good_recovery:290). cw_js_semantic_coloring:173 explicitly says 'One bar'. Visual likert anchors 0-5 each describe one scale with no waived sub-targets. Prompts and app_context add no waiver that contradicts a criterion; functional prompt.md:15 states 'A criterion is a conjunction'. Minor wording tension, not a defect: cw_mouse_selection:56 grants 'One character of pointer imprecision at either end of the drag' but its Fails clause says 'selects more or less than stated'. 'Stated' includes the tolerance, and the tolerance is bounded to the drag, so there is still one target. Weak-app probe: an app lacking Find could not pass polish keyboard_and_focus by the 'control the app does not have' carve-out alone, because the absence fails the functional find/replace criteria; the carve-out is scoped, not a waiver of most requirements. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that refuses a stale restore or appends it both pass history_restore, as stated, with no second hidden target. This row is a source-text judgement. No configured judge run exists on v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), so whether the judge actually reads these bars as single targets is NOT EXERCISED. That evidence is not required to decide this row and is not claimed.
